_comment: The paths this project does not own. Everything the project owns is resolved relative to
the repository -- by CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR in CMake, by 'git rev-parse --show-toplevel' in the
scripts -- and must stay that way; see config/README.md for the rule and its exemptions.
These values are the ones this machine was set up with. config/paths.local.json, which is
gitignored, overrides any key present in it; that is the file to edit on another machine.
${HOME} is expanded by the reader, so the user name stays out of the repository.
